Package wellen

Class EventReceiverMIDI

java.lang.Object
wellen.EventReceiverMIDI
All Implemented Interfaces:
MidiInListener
public class EventReceiverMIDI extends Object implements MidiInListener
listens to incoming MIDI messages and forwards them to callback methods of a parent object ( e.g a sketch ).

the following callback methods are available ( all are optional ): 

 
 midi_note_on(int channel, int pitch, int velocity)
 midi_note_off(int channel, int pitch, int velocity) ( or midi_note_off(int channel, int pitch) )
 midi_control_change(int channel, int number, int value)
 midi_program_change(int channel, int program) ( or deprecated midi_program_change(int channel, int number, int value) )
 midi_pitch_bend(int channel, int value) ( 0–16383, center 8192 )
 midi_channel_pressure(int channel, int pressure)
 midi_poly_pressure(int channel, int pitch, int pressure)
 midi_sysex(byte[] data)
 midi_clock_tick()
 midi_clock_start()
 midi_clock_continue()
 midi_clock_stop()
 midi_clock_song_position_pointer(int offset_16th)
 event_receive(int event, float[] data)
a note-on message with velocity 0 is delivered as note-off.

by default callbacks are called on the MIDI thread. use dispatch_on_draw_thread(boolean) to call them on the processing animation thread instead ( recommended if callbacks draw or change state used in draw() ).

    • start

      public static EventReceiverMIDI start(Object pParent, String pMidiInputDevice)
      starts receiving MIDI messages from a device. calling this method again with the same parent and device returns the existing instance.
      Parameters:
      pParent - object which will receive MIDI messages
      pMidiInputDevice - MIDI input device to use (e.g. "IAC Driver Bus 1")
      Returns:
      instance of EventReceiverMIDI. use is_initialized() to check if the device was found.

    • start

      public static EventReceiverMIDI start(Object pParent, int pMidiInputDeviceID)
      starts receiving MIDI messages from a device. calling this method again with the same parent and device returns the existing instance.
      Parameters:
      pParent - object which will receive MIDI messages
      pMidiInputDeviceID - MIDI input device ID to use ( as listed by Wellen.dumpMidiInputDevices() )

    • start

      public static EventReceiverMIDI start(Object parent, MidiIn midi_in)
      starts receiving MIDI messages from an existing MidiIn ( e.g shared with a BeatMIDI ). the MidiIn is not closed by stop().
      Parameters:
      parent - object which will receive MIDI messages
      midi_in - MIDI input
      Returns:
      instance of EventReceiverMIDI

    • dispatch_on_draw_thread

      public EventReceiverMIDI dispatch_on_draw_thread(boolean dispatch_on_draw_thread)
      Parameters:
      dispatch_on_draw_thread - if true callbacks are queued and called on the processing animation thread right before draw(). requires the parent to be a PApplet. note that callbacks are then delayed by up to one frame and are not called while the sketch is paused with noLoop().
      Returns:
      this instance
